note: Shipped defaults for the provider-pool inventory and the work-kind fit table. They reproduce a measured subscription set (readings taken 2026-09-25) so that a user with the same subscriptions gets a working configuration with no setup. Every entry is overridable per id, and a pool a user does not have is named in disabled_pools. No protected_headroom_percent is set anywhere here on purpose: a protected amount exists only where a user's own configuration sets one.

pools.note: Anthropic plan. Two rolling windows over one quota, plus a third window scoped to the Fable-tier models within the same pool. The windows are percentages over different denominators and different periods; they are inventory here, never summed.
The OpenAI plan pool. One window.
The xAI plan pool. Reported under two identifiers that are one quota.
The Gemini half of the Antigravity plan.
The shared third-party pool on the same plan, displayed as Claude and GPT together. Declared as inventory only: no model here routes to it, and its Claude half is not used at all.

models.note: Judgment tier. Draws on the pool's Fable-scoped window as well as the shared ones.
The sol lane's previous pin; declared as available inventory, preferred for no work kind by default.
Advisory voice; declared as available inventory, preferred for no work kind by default.

work_kinds.note: Driving a run. Both lanes are primary-pool, so a quota problem on one moves the work to the other.
The measured default build lane first, then both primary pools behind it.
The independent second reviewing lane, which is required to come from a different provider than the builder of the same work.
